scope: All gold candidateSet fields in training/samples/neural-cli/tsjs.
supervisionMeaning: Each gold candidateSet contains only the correct judge used for offline supervision. It is not a complete student candidate group and must not be treated as one.
legacyEpisodeFieldNote: Per-episode candidateEnumeration carries only the offline gold-supervision set status. TRAIN and DEV episodes still carry the legacy value complete under this supersession; verification episodes were corrected directly to deferred. Neither value enumerates a student candidate group.
legacyAdmissionEntry: corpus-admissions-v1.json is the explicit admission/supersession entry point. Legacy rows also carry candidateEnumerationAdmission and candidateEnumerationSupersededBy.
enumerationPlan: Student candidates must later be produced independently from typed input, including legal contrasting candidates; this corpus does not yet contain student candidate groups or a candidate converter.
episodeCandidateSetRef: Points directly to labels/gold.jsonl and carries only the offline gold-only supervision set; it does not enumerate a student candidate group.
forbiddenInterpretations: Treating a gold singleton candidateSet as a complete student candidate group.
Constructing student candidates by filtering on the gold label.
Using the gold candidateSet as the model's allowed set at inference time.
